classes.label: Outside valid coverage
classes.meaning: Outside the study area or missing data; never count as dry land.

classes.label: Neither date below the water-candidate rule
classes.meaning: Not in either candidate mask. This does not prove dry land; vegetated or urban flooding can be missed.

classes.label: Possible water on both dates
classes.meaning: Both dates meet the low-backscatter candidate rule after filtering. 两期疑似水体；并非已经确认的水体。

classes.label: Possible new water
classes.meaning: Only the later date meets the candidate rule after filtering. 疑似新增水体；不能直接等同于已确认淹水。

classes.label: Other changes to check
classes.meaning: Earlier-date candidate mask only: returns became brighter or mask membership changed near filtered edges. 回波增强、原因待核查；不得直接等同于已确认退水或农田损毁。

answer_rules: Classify observed radar signals separately from physical interpretations. All water labels are candidates, not ground truth.
Never assert confirmed inundation, recession, agricultural damage, flood depth, flood duration or affected population from these classes alone.
A negative net radar-class area change does not establish reduced flooding. New-candidate area is not net change.
Only provide pair-specific statistics when the selected ordered pair exactly matches the analysis report; no reusing August–September statistics for October or November.
